description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, Go) Department: Engineering Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Specialization: Applied AI, Full-Stack Engineering & Systems Integration Experience: 3–6 years Employment Type: Full-time Work Model: Remote / Hybrid About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers and internal teams to understand business problems, design technical solutions, and deliver production-ready software. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, and customer-facing technical implementation. You will be responsible for translating loosely defined business requirements into working applications, integrating existing systems and third-party APIs, automating workflows, and deploying solutions into production environments. The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer comfortable working across the full technology stack, making architectural decisions, troubleshooting infrastructure, and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technologies. Rather than focusing exclusively on building isolated software components, you will own problems end-to-end — from understanding the requirements to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Key Responsibilities1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business workflows, technical constraints, and operational challenges. Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve existing workflows. Build prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions. Develop customized software solutions using existing platforms, APIs, and frameworks. Own technical delivery from initial discovery through production deployment. 2. Full-Stack Application Development Design and develop web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies. Build REST APIs, backend services, and asynchronous processing workflows. Develop responsive interfaces and interactive dashboards. Integrate third-party services, APIs, and content management systems. Design and manage relational databases, data models, and application storage. Evaluate architectural trade-offs between monolithic applications, microservices, and lightweight serverless solutions. Maintain and improve existing applications while minimizing unnecessary infrastructure complexity. 3. Applied AI & LLM Integration Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications using commercial and open-source APIs. Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual information processing. Build AI-powered automation workflows for document processing, content analysis, monitoring, and summarization. Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications through APIs and reusable services. Evaluate model performance, response quality, latency, and operational costs. Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and fallback mechanisms for AI-powered workflows. Experiment with agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity. 4. Infrastructure & Deployment Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and other hosting platforms. Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployment environments. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment. Manage Linux-based servers, networking, application processes, and system services. Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform. Implement monitoring, logging, backup, and recovery mechanisms. Troubleshoot production issues and improve application reliability. Optimize infrastructure costs and operational overhead. 5. System Integration & Automation Integrate disparate business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors. Build automation scripts and lightweight services to eliminate repetitive manual tasks. Work with databases, CMS platforms, spreadsheets, and external data sources. Develop data extraction and processing workflows. Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency. Evaluate existing software platforms before deciding whether custom development is necessary. 6. Technical Ownership & Collaboration Take ownership of assigned technical projects and deliver working solutions independently. Collaborate with product managers, designers, customer success teams, and other engineers. Communicate technical decisions and implementation trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Document application architecture, deployment procedures, and integration workflows. Identify technical risks early and propose practical solutions. Balance implementation speed, maintainability, reliability, and business requirements. Required Technical Skills Programming Languages Strong proficiency in Python or another backend programming language. Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with SQL and relational databases. Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux environments. Backend Development Experience building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or equivalent. Understanding of REST architecture, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous processing. Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases. Frontend Development Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Svelte, or Vue. Experience building responsive web applications. Understanding of component-based architecture and frontend-backend integration. Applied AI Experience integrating LLM APIs into software applications. Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures. Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-powered automation. Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot LLM-based application workflows. Cloud & Infrastructure Experience deploying and maintaining applications on Linux servers or cloud platforms. Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. Exposure to infrastructure provisioning and configuration management. Engineering Practices Git-based development workflows. Debugging and production troubleshooting. API integration and documentation. Application architecture and technical documentation. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in customer-facing engineering or implementation roles. Experience building internal tools and custom business applications. Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience with Nix or other declarative environment management tools. Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Chroma. Experience with browser automation tools such as Playwright. Understanding of data visualization and dashboard development. Familiarity with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development environments. Experience working independently in remote or distributed engineering teams. What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate: Thinks in terms of problems and outcomes rather than being restricted to a particular technology stack. Can independently investigate unfamiliar systems and integrate them into working solutions. Is comfortable moving between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration tasks. Understands the practical challenges of deploying and maintaining production applications. Can work with incomplete requirements and turn ambiguity into actionable technical plans. Prefers pragmatic engineering solutions over unnecessary complexity. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Takes ownership of solutions beyond writing code. Success Metrics Performance in this role will be evaluated based on: Solution delivery: Ability to translate business requirements into functional, deployed applications. Integration effectiveness: Successful integration of third-party services, APIs, and existing systems. Engineering quality: Maintainable, reliable, and appropriately architected solutions. AI implementation: Practical adoption of AI capabilities that improve business workflows. Operational ownership: Ability to deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production systems. Customer impact: Measurable improvements in efficiency, automation, and operational processes. Example Projects Projects undertaken in this role may include: Building an AI-powered knowledge assistant using RAG and internal business documents. Automating data extraction and processing across multiple business platforms. Developing custom ERP, inventory, and operational management applications. Building automated website monitoring and AI-powered change summarization systems. Integrating existing CMS platforms with custom frontend applications. Developing internal dashboards and reporting tools. Deploying containerized applications with automated CI/CD pipelines. Building AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive administrative tasks. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. A postgraduate degree or equivalent practical experience is an advantage. Demonstrable project experience and the ability to deliver working software are highly valued. Pay: ₹1,295,000.00 - ₹2,240,000.00 per year Benefits: Paid sick time Provident Fund Work from home Ability to commute/relocate: Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred) Education: Master's (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: QA Engineer - SDET
description: About Us: Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. Website: https://www.getphyllo.com/ About the Role As an SDET, you will take ownership of automation quality for assigned product areas across APIs, SDKs and web applications. You will design scalable automation solutions, strengthen regression coverage, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and proactively identify quality risks before they reach production.. This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what “working” means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers. What you'll be expected to do 1. Build and own test automation (UI and API) Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing. Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs. Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy. Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers. Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code. Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits. Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on. 2. Work closely with product and engineering Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts. Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality. Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports. Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership. You'll be a good fit if 3–5 years of experience in quality engineering, with at least 2 years building test automation (not only running manual tests). Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience. Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java. Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e.g. Playwright, REST Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI. Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium. Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews. Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason. Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL. Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers. Nice to Have AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic). Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA.tech Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs). Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring. Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling. Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS. Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG. API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing. Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray. Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar). What we offer Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive Innovate and Evolve: We're building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact What's in it for you? We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product. Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.
